::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 17th 1877  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 24-25
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd),

I return the Agreement signed with many thanks. I shall be quite satisfied with the arrangement about [the £1000 for the copyright](organizations/other_160.qmd) being paid half next  March and half the March after.

One book you do not mention, the [Christian names](cmy_books/cmybook_48.qmd), I should be very glad if the end of that could be so got rid of, that I could cut it down correct it, add some recent discoveries and something about surnames, and make a small saleable book of it.

Yours truly
C M Yonge
